(Horizontals are at the beginning of characters, and verticals comprise the right end of characters-(that have verticals, at the end).)5 Lines of Elamite cuneiform:Line 1-(at bottom)Five cun. characters-(all end in verticals)Line 2-(probably 6 char.)-Undamaged middle character is a "vertical" w/median Horizontal following-(this is a common character for "me" (ma/me/mi/mu-No 'mo'-no o's in Akkadian/or Sumerian))Line 3-Line 4-Line 5-
